endorsements.name: Michael Weigand
endorsements.label: Build your own UAV 2.0 - Wireless Mayhem from the Heavens!
endorsements.description: Earlier this year the community was shown how to successfully Build your own Predator UAV @ 99.95% Discount - and a recon mission over DC! But now new payloads take the fun/danger to a new level! Come find out how you can not only easily warfly and conduct aerial reconnaissance for your next 'mission' but also use your UAV as a roving angel of wireless death, as always from the confines of your couch.. Or Vegas hotel room. The presenters will quickly overview how you can build your own UAV drone, and then detail how to outfit it to conduct wireless recon, attack, penetration, and other goodies.. Several demo mission from the Vegas Strip will be presented with video!
